description: Round 5 candidate lr2e5 (configs/recipes_v1.json): exactly train_s1_base_a3.json (A3) with the stage 2 learning rate 2e-05 instead of 3e-5; checkpoints (the frozen S3 runs of the same seed), labels (the ORIGINAL teacher labels, build 20261004-teacher100 setting T), schedule, batch, eval cadence, patience and seeds as A3. One point of the learning-rate grid 2e-5 / 3e-5 (= A3) / 5e-5 that every round 6 backbone also gets. Trainer: python -m novel_ner.tagger train. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test. --- A3: Stage 1 arm A3: the base backbone first trained on the 749 training chapters' weak S3 labels (the existing, frozen S3 checkpoints runs/20261003-tag-S3-s<seed>-dev31, one per seed) and then fine-tuned on the 100 teacher chapters' Opus labels (setting T of weak build 20261004-teacher100), NEEDLE's two-stage recipe. init_from_run names the checkpoint to start from; '{seed}' is replaced by the run's seed, so seed 1 starts from the S3 seed-1 run, seed 2 from seed 2, and so on (the pairing is recorded in config.json as init_from, with that run's config.json sha256). The run refuses a checkpoint from another backbone id. Everything else (schedule, lr, batch, sufficiency record, checkpoint rule) is train_s1_base: about 1300 planned steps, dev every 2 epochs, patience 6; the sufficiency record shows whether fine-tuning from a trained model needed fewer steps. Intended setting: T only (A3 compares with A2 = T from the fresh backbone: does the weak pre-training still help once teacher labels exist?); W from an S3 checkpoint would re-train on the same label source and is not an arm. Three seeds. Nothing tuned on dev2 or the test.
init_from_run_note: '{seed}' is filled with --seed; the named run must be finished (metrics.json, checkpoints/best) and use the same backbone id

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,578,458 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 412 MB); no safetensors in the repo

planned_steps_note: as train_s1_base: about 32 steps per epoch x 40 epochs = about 1300 steps
